channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: FBI agent who responded to Pentagon on 9/11 now battles health issues
item.description: The retired FBI special agent is pushing for changes to the WTC Health Program.

item.title: Trump centers himself in midterms at GOP convention
item.description: At his party's largest event, Trump placed himself at the center of the midterms, telling supporters to act as if he were on the ballot.

item.title: U.S. military aircraft damaged in Iranian strikes on Jordan base
item.description: An A-10 Thunderbolt attack aircraft, known as the Warthog, was hit and lost a wing, according to sources.

item.title: U.S. destroys another alleged drug boat as Rubio defends strikes
item.description: Since Trump returned to power, U.S. airstrikes on boats in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific have killed more than 200 people.
